definition: to finish a task by the time it is due
vi: kịp thời hạn, hoàn thành đúng hạn
example: Our team worked late on Thursday to meet a deadline for the year-end inventory report.

definition: with very little warning or time to prepare
vi: báo gấp, trong thời gian ngắn (không được báo trước nhiều)
example: My manager asked me to work the Saturday shift on short notice because two people called in sick.

definition: to be the person responsible for something or someone
vi: phụ trách, chịu trách nhiệm về
example: Starting next month, Linh will be in charge of all incoming shipments at the warehouse.
collocations: be in charge of a project

definition: to accept a job, duty or responsibility
vi: đảm nhận, nhận thêm (công việc, trách nhiệm)
example: After her coworker left, Maria agreed to take on the payroll duties as well.

definition: to work during someone else's scheduled working time
vi: làm thay ca (cho người khác)
example: Could you cover a shift for me on Friday evening? I have a medical appointment.
collocations: cover a shift for a coworker

definition: extra hours worked beyond your normal working hours
vi: làm thêm giờ, giờ làm thêm
example: During the holiday season, warehouse staff often work overtime to keep up with orders.

definition: a regular meeting where a manager evaluates how well an employee is doing
vi: buổi đánh giá hiệu quả công việc
example: In my last performance review, my supervisor praised my accuracy with invoices.

definition: a person you work with at the same company
vi: đồng nghiệp
example: One of my coworkers showed me how to use the new scheduling software.

definition: a person who manages and checks the work of employees
vi: người giám sát, quản lý trực tiếp
example: Please let your supervisor know at least two weeks before you take vacation days.

definition: to pay someone back for money they spent, often for work
vi: hoàn trả, bồi hoàn (chi phí)
example: The company will reimburse you for parking and mileage when you visit clients.

definition: the amount of work a person or team has to do
vi: khối lượng công việc
example: Since we hired two new clerks, my workload has become much more manageable.

definition: to give part of your work or responsibility to someone else
vi: giao việc, ủy thác (cho người khác)
example: A good manager knows how to delegate routine tasks so she can focus on planning.

definition: to decide which tasks are most important and do them first
vi: ưu tiên, sắp xếp thứ tự ưu tiên
example: When everything seems urgent, I prioritize the orders that must ship the same day.

definition: to take further action or check again about something
vi: theo dõi, xử lý tiếp (một việc đã nêu trước đó)
example: I'm writing to follow up on the purchase order I sent you last Tuesday.

definition: to contact someone again later, usually with an answer
vi: liên hệ lại, phản hồi lại (sau)
example: Let me check the delivery schedule and get back to you by the end of the day.
collocations: get back to someone with an answer
get back to me as soon as possible

definition: all the goods a business has in stock; also the process of counting them
vi: hàng tồn kho; việc kiểm kê hàng
example: We do a full inventory count every January before the new fiscal year begins.

definition: a load of goods that is sent or delivered together
vi: lô hàng, chuyến hàng
example: The shipment from Toronto was delayed by two days because of a snowstorm.

definition: a build-up of work that has not been done yet
vi: công việc tồn đọng, dồn ứ
example: After the system outage, the accounting team had a backlog of over 200 invoices to process.

definition: to make a process simpler and more efficient
vi: tinh gọn, hợp lý hóa (quy trình)
example: The new barcode scanners helped streamline the receiving process at our distribution centre.

definition: how much work a person or company produces in a given time
vi: năng suất
example: Some managers believe that working from home increases productivity, while others disagree.

definition: the level of confidence and enthusiasm in a group of people
vi: tinh thần (làm việc) của tập thể
example: The team lunch every Friday has really improved staff morale.

definition: to work together with others to achieve something
vi: hợp tác, cộng tác
example: Our logistics and sales departments collaborate closely to plan delivery routes.

definition: experience gained by actually doing something, not just studying it
vi: kinh nghiệm thực tế
example: The co-op placement gave me hands-on experience with forklift operation and inventory systems.

definition: a public notice that advertises an open position
vi: tin tuyển dụng
example: I saw a job posting for an accounts payable clerk on the city's website.

definition: the skills, education or experience that make someone suitable for a job
vi: trình độ, bằng cấp, điều kiện chuyên môn
example: Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications, including two years of bookkeeping experience.

definition: a letter from a former employer or teacher describing your skills and character
vi: thư giới thiệu, thư tham chiếu
example: My previous manager kindly wrote me a reference letter for my new job application.

definition: to officially leave your job by choice
vi: từ chức, xin nghỉ việc
example: He decided to resign from his position after being offered a job closer to home.

definition: to end someone's employment because there is not enough work or money
vi: cho nghỉ việc, sa thải (do thiếu việc/cắt giảm)
example: The plant had to lay off forty workers when its biggest contract ended.

definition: a move to a higher position at work
vi: sự thăng chức
example: After three years as a clerk, she received a promotion to office manager.

definition: an increase in the amount of money you are paid
vi: sự tăng lương
example: Employees who complete the safety certification will receive a pay raise of one dollar an hour.

definition: the extra advantages an employer offers besides pay, such as health and dental coverage
vi: gói phúc lợi (cho nhân viên)
example: The salary is a bit lower, but the benefits package includes dental and vision coverage.

definition: time off work, often paid, when you are ill
vi: nghỉ ốm (có phép)
example: In British Columbia, many employees are entitled to five days of paid sick leave per year.

definition: a work schedule where employees can choose when they start and finish
vi: giờ làm việc linh hoạt
example: Flexible hours allow parents to drop their kids off at school before starting work.

definition: to do your job from home or another place outside the office
vi: làm việc từ xa
example: Since the pandemic, many accountants in Vancouver work remotely two or three days a week.

definition: a session that introduces new people to a workplace or program
vi: buổi định hướng, buổi giới thiệu (cho người mới)
example: All new hires must attend a half-day orientation before their first shift.

definition: a regular meeting for all the employees in a team or workplace
vi: cuộc họp nhân viên
example: The new vacation policy will be explained at Monday's staff meeting.

definition: a list of topics to be discussed at a meeting
vi: chương trình nghị sự, nội dung cuộc họp
example: Please send me any items you want to add to the agenda by Wednesday.

definition: to change the time or date of a planned event
vi: dời lịch, sắp xếp lại thời gian
example: Would it be possible to reschedule our meeting to Thursday afternoon?

definition: needing to be dealt with quickly because time is limited
vi: gấp, cần xử lý kịp thời
example: This request is time-sensitive, so please approve the payment before 3 p.m.

definition: to make brief contact with someone to share updates
vi: liên lạc nhanh, trao đổi ngắn để cập nhật
example: Let's touch base next week to see how the new delivery route is working.

definition: to learn the latest information so you can do a task well
vi: nắm bắt kịp (thông tin, công việc)
example: It took me about two weeks to get up to speed with the company's accounting software.
collocations: get up to speed on a project

definition: not having enough workers to do the job properly
vi: thiếu nhân sự
example: The store has been understaffed all summer, so customers often wait a long time.

definition: giving good results for the amount of money spent
vi: hiệu quả về chi phí, tiết kiệm
example: Shipping by rail is often more cost-effective than trucking for heavy loads.

definition: rules and practices that protect workers from injury at work
vi: an toàn lao động, an toàn nơi làm việc
example: WorkSafeBC inspectors visited the warehouse to check workplace safety procedures.

definition: arriving or doing something at the expected time; not late
vi: đúng giờ
example: My supervisor appreciates that I'm always punctual, even in winter traffic.

definition: a formal phrase used to tell the reader a file is included with an email
vi: vui lòng xem tệp đính kèm
example: Please find attached my updated availability for the month of December.
collocations: please find attached a copy of

definition: to start doing a job or duty that someone else was doing
vi: tiếp quản, đảm nhận thay
example: While Kevin is on parental leave, Anna will take over his client accounts.

definition: to do someone's job temporarily while they are away
vi: làm thay, thay thế tạm thời
example: I'm filling in for the receptionist this week, so I may be slow to answer emails.
collocations: ask someone to fill in for you

definition: to have far too much work or too many things to deal with
vi: ngập đầu (công việc), bận tối mặt
example: Sorry for the late reply; I've been swamped with year-end reports all week.

definition: the confidence that you will not lose your job
vi: sự ổn định công việc, an toàn việc làm
example: For many newcomers, job security matters more than a slightly higher salary.

definition: to formally ask an employer to give you a job, usually by sending a résumé or form
vi: nộp đơn xin việc
example: I applied for a job at the new warehouse in Delta, and they called me for an interview the next day.
collocations: apply for a job in person

definition: a job in which you work the normal number of hours each week
vi: vị trí làm việc toàn thời gian
example: After six months as a part-time cashier, she was offered a full-time position with benefits.

definition: a day when you do not have to go to work
vi: ngày nghỉ
example: I'm taking a day off on Friday to help my parents move into their new apartment.

definition: the tasks and responsibilities that are part of a job
vi: nhiệm vụ công việc
example: My job duties include checking orders, answering customer emails and training new staff.

definition: to record the time you start work, often by scanning a card or using an app
vi: chấm công vào ca
example: Please remember to clock in as soon as you arrive, or your hours may not be recorded correctly.

definition: to exchange working times with a coworker
vi: đổi ca làm
example: If you need to swap shifts with someone, get your manager's approval at least a few days in advance.

definition: to formally tell your employer that you are going to leave your job
vi: nộp đơn báo nghỉ việc
example: Before you hand in your notice, make sure you have a written offer from the new company.
collocations: hand in your notice in writing
decide to hand in your notice
hand in your notice to your manager

definition: a person who has recently started working for a company
vi: nhân viên mới
example: Every new hire spends the first week shadowing an experienced team member.

definition: training that you get while you are doing a job, rather than in a classroom
vi: đào tạo tại chỗ (vừa làm vừa học)
example: The position includes paid on-the-job training, so you don't need any previous warehouse experience.

definition: to do your job well when there is a lot of stress or little time
vi: làm việc dưới áp lực
example: In a busy restaurant kitchen, you have to work under pressure without losing your temper.

definition: to be as good as someone hoped or required
vi: đáp ứng kỳ vọng
example: The new scheduling software didn't meet expectations, so the team went back to the old system.

definition: the person you should communicate with about a particular matter
vi: đầu mối liên hệ
example: While Grace is on leave, Marco will be your main point of contact for all supplier questions.
collocations: act as the point of contact

definition: to make sure someone is updated about what is happening
vi: cập nhật thông tin cho ai đó
example: Please keep me in the loop about the delivery schedule so I can plan the staff shifts.
collocations: keep the team in the loop

definition: to finish a meeting, task or project
vi: kết thúc, hoàn tất
example: Let's wrap up the meeting now and continue the discussion on Thursday.

definition: making the progress needed to succeed or finish on time
vi: đúng tiến độ
example: Despite the supply delays, we're still on track to open the new location in March.

definition: the first weeks or months of a new job, when the employer decides whether you are suitable
vi: thời gian thử việc
example: During the probation period, new employees meet with their manager every two weeks to discuss progress.

definition: specific tasks that people agree to do after a meeting
vi: các việc cần làm (sau cuộc họp)
example: I'll send out the meeting notes with a list of action items and who is responsible for each one.

definition: the whole process, often lasting weeks, of helping new employees learn about their job and the company
vi: quá trình hội nhập nhân viên mới
example: Our onboarding process now includes a buddy system, so new hires always have someone to ask.

definition: to make more effort than is expected of you
vi: nỗ lực hơn mức yêu cầu
example: Customers remember staff who go the extra mile, like carrying heavy boxes out to their car.
collocations: be willing to go the extra mile
go the extra mile for customers

definition: to take more responsibility or make more effort when it is needed
vi: đứng ra gánh vác, tăng cường nỗ lực
example: When our manager got sick during inventory week, two senior staff members stepped up to run the shifts.

definition: to do something useful before other people do or without being told to
vi: chủ động
example: Managers want staff who take the initiative, like Kim, who created a checklist for closing the store that everyone now uses.

definition: to end a disagreement between people by finding a solution
vi: giải quyết mâu thuẫn
example: Our team leader is good at resolving conflicts before they affect the rest of the staff.

definition: skills, such as communication or problem-solving, that are useful in many different jobs
vi: kỹ năng có thể chuyển đổi
example: Even if your experience abroad was in a different field, highlight your transferable skills in your cover letter.

definition: to do your fair share of the work in a group
vi: làm tròn phần việc của mình
example: If you want to stay on this small team, you need to pull your weight and finish your share of the orders.
collocations: expect people to pull their weight

definition: a point in a process where work slows down because there is too much to handle
vi: điểm nghẽn
example: Having only one person approve every order has become a bottleneck for the whole warehouse.

definition: to communicate and work with another person or group so that everyone has the same information
vi: phối hợp, liên lạc với
example: In this role, you will liaise with suppliers and the shipping team to make sure orders arrive on time.
